text:
ana_marketing: Heads-up: final prep for Optimize v2 public announcement. Target publish Wed 12:30 PT. Need final changelog URL, docs link, and canary window confirmation. Also want benchmark snippet and webinar CTA in the post. @ravi_eng @zoe_docs

ravi_eng: Changelog done: https://docs.redwood.ai/changelog/optimize-v2. Docs to link -> https://docs.redwood.ai/optimize/v2-runbook. Canary suggested 06:00-08:00 PT to avoid traffic; small canary (5%).

zoe_docs: I'll push the docs update by 11:00 PT. Will include benchmark figures + methodology appendix. Draft language: "~1.9x median throughput on mixed generation workloads vs v1 with same latency" — marketing can tweak.

ethan_prod: Webinar at 12:30 PT confirmed. We'd like a short demo showing cache-hit improvements and a Q&A slot. Marketing: can you include registration link and note that demo requests go to Sales Ops queue?

ana_marketing: Registration -> https://redwood.ai/events/optimize-v2. Please confirm lead routing: webinar signups -> SFDC queue "Launch_Readouts", demo requests -> "AE_Handoff". Also want utm tags: utm_campaign=optimize_v2_launch

ravi_eng: Confirm routing. Rollout command for ops on canary:
```
rwd deploy start --bundle optimize-v2 --env prod --canary-percent 5 --duration 2h
```
Fallback variant: optimize-v2-compat (q4). Smoke checks: p95 < 300ms, error rate < 1%.

ops_bot: Canary scheduled 06:00 PT. Oncall rotation: primary @ravi_eng, secondary @ethan_prod. Alerts: p95_latency, error_rate, cache_hit_rate.

zoe_docs: Note: benchmark numbers are per our internal mixed workload harness. I'll attach the CSV and a brief caveats section by noon.

ana_marketing: Thanks. I'll queue the blog + benchmark thread for 12:30 PT and prep a short FAQ for support. If canary is delayed, we hold publish by default. Please flag here if anything changes. :raised_hands:

ravi_eng: I'll be online 05:30-09:30 PT for rollout. If auto-rollback triggers, ops will revert to optimize-v1 and update this thread.

ethan_prod: Sales playbook link posted to #sales-ops. Tagging demo leads: @AE_team. Good to go from product side. :rocket:
